name: Ch’ien Ch’i
bio: Ch’ien Ch’i graduated at the government examinations in AD 751.
The poems here are Witter Bynner’s versions, from the texts of Kiang Kang-hu, in The Jade Mountain (1929).

poems.title: Farewell to a Japanese Buddhist Priest Bound Homeward
poems.author: Ch’ien Ch’i
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
You were foreordained to find the source.
Now, tracing your way as in a dream
There where the sea floats up the sky,
You wane from the world in your fragile boat. . . .
The water and the moon are as calm as your faith,
Fishes and dragons follow your chanting,
And the eye still watches beyond the horizon
The holy light of your single lantern.

poems.title: From My Study at the Mouth of the Valley, a Message to Censor Yang
poems.author: Ch’ien Ch’i
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
At a little grass-hut in the valley of the river,
Where a cloud seems born from a viney wall,
You will love the bamboos new with rain,
And mountains tender in the sunset.
Cranes drift early here to rest
And autumn flowers are slow to fade. . . .
I have bidden my pupil to sweep the grassy path
For the coming of my friend.

poems.title: To My Friend at the Capital, Secretary P’ei
poems.author: Ch’ien Ch’i
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
Finches flash yellow through the Imperial Grove
Of the Forbidden City, pale with spring dawn;
Flowers muffle a bell in the Palace of Bliss
And rain has deepened the Dragon Lake willows;
But spring is no help to a man bewildered,
Who would be like a cloud upholding the Light of Heaven,
Yet whose poems, ten years refused, are shaming
These white hairs held by the petalled pin.

poems.title: 逢俠者 (Feng xia zhe)
poems.author: Ch’ien Ch’i
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
燕趙悲歌士，相逢劇孟家。
寸心言不盡，前路日將斜。

poems.title: 江行望匡廬 (Jiang xing wang kuang lu)
poems.author: Ch’ien Ch’i
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
咫尺愁風雨，匡廬不可登。
只疑雲霧窟，猶有六朝僧。

poems.title: 歸雁 (Gui yan)
poems.author: Ch’ien Ch’i
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
瀟湘何事等閒回，水碧沙明兩岸苔。
二十五絃彈夜月，不勝清怨卻飛來。

poems.title: 送僧歸日本 (Song seng gui ri ben)
poems.author: Ch’ien Ch’i
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
上國隨緣住，來途若夢行。
浮天滄海遠，去世法舟輕。
水月通禪寂，魚龍聽梵聲。
惟憐一燈影，萬里眼中明。

poems.title: 谷口書齋寄楊補闕 (Gu kou shu zhai ji yang bu que)
poems.author: Ch’ien Ch’i
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
泉壑帶茅茨，雲霞生薜帷。
竹憐新雨後，山愛夕陽時。
閒鷺棲常早，秋花落更遲。
家僮掃蘿徑，昨與故人期。

poems.title: 贈闕下裴舍人 (Zeng que xia pei she ren)
poems.author: Ch’ien Ch’i
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
二月黃鶯飛上林，春城紫禁曉陰陰。
長樂鐘聲花外盡，龍池柳色雨中深。
陽和不散窮途恨，霄漢長懷捧日心。
獻賦十年猶未遇，羞將白髮對華簪。
